title: Women and Lung Cancer Research and Preventive Services Act of 2025

errors.claim: assess barriers to participation of women and underserved populations in lung cancer research; and recommend strategies to improve that participation
errors.problem: Invented review element. The bill's mandated review (SEC 2) contains no reference to participation, barriers to participation, or enrollment in research/studies, and no directive to recommend strategies to improve participation. This reads like generic clinical-trial-diversity language supplied from outside the text. The same claim also appears in the top_line sub ('barriers to participation in lung cancer studies'). The bill's actual scope is research status/knowledge gaps, collaborative research, environmental/genomic etiology, imaging, a screening-access strategy, and a public-awareness campaign.
errors.sourceTruth: absent from source. Nearest source text: (b)(2)(A) 'encourage innovative approaches to eliminate knowledge gaps in research on lung cancer in women'; (b)(3) 'opportunities regarding the development of a national lung cancer screening strategy to expand access to such screenings, particularly among women and underserved populations' — no 'participation'/'barriers' language anywhere
